title: Dick Harper falsified personnel records

tellings.quote: He said, "Well, roughly [music] 200 people were involved in the whole Aztec recovery, so I kept 200 personnel records to make sure nobody was ever really an Aztec."

plain: A man named Dick Harper is said to have kept false personnel records so that no one could ever be shown to have taken part in the Aztec recovery, the claimed 1948 retrieval of a crashed craft and its bodies near Aztec, New Mexico. Scott Ramsey, who has looked into the Aztec story, says Harper told him this: "roughly 200 people were involved in the whole Aztec recovery, so I kept 200 personnel records to make sure nobody was ever really an Aztec." If true, it would explain why the people said to have been there leave no trace in the records.
